name: online_learner
description: Online learning module. Updates the agent's parameters from each new experience in real time. This is what makes the agent improve with use rather than being frozen at training time.

components.name: lora_adaptation
components.description: Low-rank adaptation of base model weights for fast task-specific learning

components.name: retrieval_update
components.description: Update memory stores with new experiences (non-parametric learning)

components.name: reward_model_update
components.description: Refine internal reward model based on observed outcomes

update_triggers.description: Surprise = divergence between predicted and actual outcome
